title: Compile screen operations directly into video prediction commands

definition.title: Compile screen operations directly into video prediction commands
definition.source_excerpt: Prepare a constrained predictive video stream from known block-aligned screen copy/scroll/replace operations, instead of general motion estimation. Compare a reference scene and total producer/player work; this requires a producer-assisted encoder.
definition.impact_basis: Useful stage/operation improvement if the target workload and repeated use exist. Scope comes from the cited card; exposure and effect size are unmeasured.
definition.default_next_action: Identify the preview operation and current service. Separate sparse previews, exact scrubbing and ordinary playback; inspect prior frame/history reuse.
definition.minimum_probe: One short owned source and a few target requests under equal memory budgets, with an independent full-decode/reference result.
definition.initial_screen: Identify the preview operation and current service. Separate sparse previews, exact scrubbing and ordinary playback; inspect prior frame/history reuse. One short owned source and a few target requests under equal memory budgets, with an independent full-decode/reference result.
definition.primary_metric: Time to the requested exact or explicitly approximate preview, total prerequisite work and retained state.
definition.scope_contract: Correct source/time/target and agreed fidelity. Approximate results cannot populate exact caches or qualify normal playback.
definition.negative_control: Move backward, request a non-RAP dependency, change source or cancel a pending request; stale previews must never become current.
definition.stop_boundary: Stop at E3 preview/index/state infrastructure. Keep proof of a bounded mechanism distinct from a production preview implementation.
definition.shared_prerequisite: Existing preview or decoder access path. Its absence is setup cost, not permission to create a complete preview service.
definition.reopen_condition: A new applicable workload, resolved prerequisite, better independent oracle, or materially different bounded implementation changes the recorded decision.
definition.relevance_basis: Editorial fit to ordinary Demuxe playback goals, not measured prevalence; rerank after one local opportunity audit.

results.basis: Producer-owned aligned screen replace/copy commands become actual CAVLC I_PCM replacement and skip-run video, without motion estimation. All30 full I420 frames and PTS match independent host and Chrome, including frame_num wrap. Legal-but-stale skipped replacement remains decodable but corrupts27expectedpictures; out-of-bounds/color/timeline guards reject. Against in-process lossless x264 with incremental raster updates,7paired complete local producer+player jobs median0.8643x cost but bootstrap95[0.6080,1.0096] does not establish a reliable gain. Coded bytes26942 versus7810 (3.45x) also matter. Correct capability, cost inconclusive.
